Fitting models

nbreg()
Negative binomial regression by IRLS and Newton-Raphson
zinbreg()
Zero-inflated negative binomial regression by EM with IRLS M-steps

Control settings for nbreg()

print(<nbreg>) summary(<nbreg>) print(<summary.nbreg>) coef(<nbreg>) vcov(<nbreg>) logLik(<nbreg>) fitted(<nbreg>) residuals(<nbreg>) nobs(<nbreg>) predict(<nbreg>)
Methods for nbreg fits
print(<zinbreg>) summary(<zinbreg>) print(<summary.zinbreg>) coef(<zinbreg>) vcov(<zinbreg>) logLik(<zinbreg>) fitted(<zinbreg>) residuals(<zinbreg>) nobs(<zinbreg>) predict(<zinbreg>)
Methods for zinbreg fits

Inference

Confidence intervals, likelihood-ratio tests of nested models, the overdispersion test, and the comparison of a zero-inflated fit with a negative binomial fit.

confint(<nbreg>) print(<nbzinbreg_confint>) confint(<zinbreg>)
Confidence intervals for nbreg and zinbreg fits
anova(<nbreg>) anova(<zinbreg>) print(<nbzinbreg_anova>)
Likelihood-ratio tests for nested nbreg or zinbreg fits
overdispersion_test()
Test for overdispersion: Poisson against negative binomial
vuong_test() print(<nbzinbreg_vuong>)
Compare a zinbreg fit with an nbreg fit

Simulation and bootstrap

simulate(<nbreg>) simulate(<zinbreg>)
Simulate responses from nbreg and zinbreg fits
boot_se() print(<nbzinbreg_boot>)
Parametric bootstrap standard errors

Diagnostics

expected_counts()
Observed and expected count frequencies
rootogram()
Rootogram of observed and expected count frequencies
